_note: Build settings. season_start/season_end bound the regular season: SeatGeek events outside it (preseason, playoffs) are ignored. The build fails when SeatGeek returns fewer NBA regular-season games than min_events, scaled down as the season is played: the floor is min(min_events, min_ratio x games still to play). Games still to play are estimated from the Ticketmaster schedule (25 teams) scaled to 30 teams. Without the scaling a fixed 900 would fail every build from early December.
